06 — How I work

Idea to post. All by me.

  1. Idea
  2. →
  3. Execution
  4. →
  5. Distribution
  6. →
  7. Analysis

Idea

I spot formats, sounds and topics early and turn them into on-brand ideas. Visa and policy news gets checked before anything goes out, and I keep up with platform algorithms and best practices.

Idea

I build campaign-specific content calendars with timelines and follow-ups, so every post has a goal, a date and an owner.

Execution

I write the concept, caption and on-screen hook for each post and Reel, so the first seconds earn the watch.

Execution

Short-form edits in CapCut, and posters, news-style carousels, thumbnails and banners in Canva, Photoshop and Illustrator, all following brand guidelines.

Execution

Daily contact with clients and the consultancy team: briefs, feedback, approvals and on-time delivery. Influencer collaborations are coordinated here too.

Distribution

I schedule and publish across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube, repurposing one idea into the format each platform needs.

Analysis

I track reach, views, shares and engagement for every post. New hooks and formats get tested; what performs stays, and what does not is dropped.
